description: Chiamaka Nwabanne publishes code and derived inputs for comparing mobile-broadband intervention priorities across Nigeria. The August 2026 Zenodo reproducibility package is free under the MIT licence. It includes a table for thirty-six states and the Federal Capital Territory and calculates a mobile-broadband quality index, population-weighted gaps, five priority rules and catch-up scenarios. Documented sensitivity checks vary aggregation, reference choices and component weights. These outputs can support scenario comparisons for communication-infrastructure investment planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this priority workflow. Raw Ookla tiles and WorldPop rasters are not redistributed. The exact input observation period, table schema, implementation language and reproduction instructions inside the ZIP were not independently established. Priority scores reflect chosen definitions and weights; they are not causal estimates of the benefit of construction or service upgrades. The code was not executed and reported headline checks were not reproduced.
